lines.en: label beachmas10:
scene twogirlsonabed1
: {i}Okay, okay! It’s my turn again...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好好好！又轮到我了……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Two truths and a lie. I played with dolls until I was ten...I keep a secret journal somewhere in my house that no one has ever seen before...and I once had a crush on Molly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}两个真心话一个谎话。我玩娃娃玩到十岁……我在家里某个地方藏了一本从来没人见过的秘密日记……还有我曾经暗恋过 Molly。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s gotta be the Molly one.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}肯定是 Molly 那条。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Of course it’s the heckin’ Molly one! Arborea’s had her sights set on the same man since childhood! But she didn’t need to just blatantly rub it in like that!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然就是那个该死的 Molly 啊！Arborea 从小就把目光锁定在同一个男人身上了！但她也没必要这么明目张胆地炫耀吧！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hey, you don’t know that for sure! What if I’ve just been really good at holding it in? {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿，你又不能确定！万一我一直都藏得特别好呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don’t tempt her, Ami. She has a track record of kissing people during Christmas parties.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别撩她，Ami。她有在圣诞派对上亲人的前科。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}So do you! Or have you already forgotten the trauma you inflicted on me?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你也有！还是你已经忘了你给我造成过多大的心理创伤？！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As if I’d ever forget kissing you! Come here. Let’s do it again for old time’s sake.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我怎么可能忘了亲你那件事！过来。看在往日情分上，我们再来一次吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}My, my. This game is proving to be significantly more exciting than truth or dare was.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哎呀哎呀。这个游戏显然比真心话大冒险刺激多了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No wonder Touka bailed right away. But at least we got- woah. Chika, where are you going? You were up next.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}难怪 Touka 跑得那么快。不过至少我们——哇哦。Chika，你要去哪儿？下一个就是你啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, I’m done for now. You guys can play without me. I’m gonna go take a break in the other room.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，我先不玩了。你们不用管我，继续玩吧。我去隔壁房间休息一下。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you sure? I think Rin’s in-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你确定吗？我觉得 Rin 在——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yup! I’ll just chill with her while you guys have fun.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对！你们玩你们的，我就陪她待着。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Afraid of revealing too many truths? {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怕爆出太多真心话？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Pfft, as if. Laters.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}噗，才没有。回见。{/i}

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed2
: Hey.
: You gonna sulk in here all night? Or do you want to maybe {i}try{/i} having some amount of fun before New Year's rolls around?
lines.zh: : 你打算在这儿生一整晚闷气？还是说想在跨年之前稍微{i}找点乐子{/i}？

lines.en: : I was planning on sulking...so please feel free to go have fun without me.
lines.zh: : 我本来就打算生闷气……所以你们尽管去玩，不用管我。

lines.en: : Is this depression talking? Or is this “I wish my girlfriend was here” talking?
lines.zh: : 这是抑郁在说话？还是"我希望我女朋友在这儿"在说话？

lines.en: : I probably wouldn’t be talking at all if it were depression. But it’s a lot more complicated than just wishing Otoha was here.
lines.zh: : 如果是抑郁的话，我大概一句话都不会说。但这比单纯希望 Otoha 在这儿要复杂得多。

lines.en: : That so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Move over.
lines.zh: : 挪过去点。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed3
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I said move over. I’ll lie with you if you’re going to be so much of a buzzkill that you won’t even play party games with your friends.
lines.zh: : 我说挪过去点。你要是扫兴到连跟朋友玩派对游戏都不肯，那我就陪你躺着。

lines.en: : I don’t really think that’s a good idea, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不太是个好主意，Chika。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed4
: Why not? Worried you might fall for me again?
lines.zh: : 为什么不是？怕你又会爱上我？

lines.en: : Would it help if I threw a shirt on? Oh- but I left my bag in the other room.
lines.zh: : 我套件上衣会不会好点？哦——但我把包落在隔壁房间了。

lines.en: : Could I maybe borrow one of yours? Or would that make us look too much like girlfriends?
lines.zh: : 我能借你一件吗？还是说那样会让我们看起来太像情侣了？

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed5
: Borrow whatever you want. We’re girls. Our clothes are basically made for trading.
lines.zh: : 想借什么就借什么。我们都是女生。我们的衣服本来就是拿来互相换着穿的。

lines.en: : Just...don’t lie down. Because if someone comes in and sees us and then Otoha finds out, it’ll be a whole-
lines.zh: : 只是……别躺下来。因为要是有人进来撞见我们，然后 Otoha 知道了，那又会是一场——

lines.en: : {i}Fuck{/i} Otoha.
lines.zh: : {i}去他妈的{/i} Otoha。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed6
: God, I wish it was that easy.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真希望事情有那么简单。

lines.en: : First, eww. Second, aww. Third, move the fuck over, girl.
lines.zh: : 第一，恶。第二，哇好甜。第三，给我他妈挪过去，丫头。

lines.en: : Right after talking shit on my girlfriend? I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 刚说完我女朋友坏话？我可不干。

lines.en: : If your girlfriend is going to make you feel like {i}this,{/i} I think I’ve got the right to say a few mean things about her. Come on. Let me take your mind off of stuff.
lines.zh: : 如果你女朋友要让你{i}这么难受{/i}，那我觉得我有资格说她几句难听的。拜托，让我帮你分散一下注意力。

lines.en: : Are you still going to want to take my mind off of stuff when I stay glued to my phone the entire time, hoping she texts me?
lines.zh: : 要是我一直黏在手机上、盼着她给我发消息，你还会想让我分散注意力吗？

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed7
: Yeah.
: And do you wanna know why?
lines.zh: : 想知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : Don’t say it, Chika.
lines.zh: : 别说，Chika。

lines.en: : Because I love you.
lines.zh: : 因为我爱你。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed8
: And even if you don’t feel tempted to sniff my hair every time I’m opening my locker now, I know you love me too.
lines.zh: : 就算你现在不再每次我开储物柜时都想闻我的头发了，我也知道你同样爱我。

lines.en: : But Otoha-
lines.zh: : 可 Otoha——

lines.en: : I knew you first.
lines.zh: : 我先认识的你。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t make it okay to-
lines.zh: : 但这不代表就可以——

lines.en: : Platonically share the same bed with a girl who cares about you and wants to make you feel better? Gee, silly me. I can see now why you’re so against the idea.
lines.zh: : 跟一个在乎你、想让你好受些的女孩纯洁地躺在同一张床上？哎呀，我可真傻。现在我明白你为什么这么反对了。

lines.en: : Rin, either you move over...or I am going to come over there and use my crazy bitch strength to move you myself.
lines.zh: : Rin，你要么自己挪过去……要么我就过来，用我的疯婆子力气亲自把你挪开。

lines.en: : Well, when you put it that way...guess I don’t have much of a choice.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你都这么说了……看来我也没什么选择。

lines.en: : You never did and you never will.
lines.zh: : 你从来就没有过，以后也不会有。

lines.en: scene black
: Thanks for having me~
lines.zh: : 谢谢收留我~

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed9
: There. That wasn’t so hard, was it?
lines.zh: : 看吧。也没那么难，对不对？

lines.en: : No, obviously not. But that doesn’t mean it doesn’t feel weird for me.
lines.zh: : 是，显然不难。但这不代表对我来说就不别扭。

lines.en: : Does it {i}actually{/i} feel weird? Are you {i}actually{/i} tempted to climb on top of me right now? Or are you just {i}saying{/i} it feels weird because you know it would piss off Otoha if she walked in?
lines.zh: : {i}真的{/i}别扭吗？你现在{i}真的{/i}想爬到我身上来吗？还是你只是因为知道 Otoha 要是走进来会气炸，才{i}说{/i}别扭的？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I don’t know anything anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我现在什么都不知道了。

lines.en: : Ahh, the woes of love.
lines.zh: : 啊，恋爱的苦恼。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed10
: One minute, it’s like you’ve got the whole world in the palms of your hands. But the next, it’s like all of the water on it’s begun spilling through your fingers.
lines.zh: : 前一分钟，你仿佛把整个世界都捧在了掌心。下一分钟，上面的水却开始从你的指缝间漏光。

lines.en: : It’s disorienting and scary and you never know what’s going to happen next. So you start thinking, “Hey...maybe I’m not the right person to hold this thing?”
lines.zh: : 它让人迷失、让人害怕，你永远不知道下一刻会发生什么。于是你开始想，"嘿……也许我根本不是该捧着这东西的人？"

lines.en: : But the more you think about someone else holding it, the worse everything starts to feel.
lines.zh: : 可你越是去想由别人来捧着它，一切就越是让人难受。

lines.en: : So you hang on as if your life depends on it...because it’s better than the alternative. Better than never knowing.
lines.zh: : 于是你死死抓着不放，仿佛性命攸关……因为这总比另一个选择好。总比永远不知道要好。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed11
: Sorry. That probably sounded a little cheesy, didn’t it? I know I’m not as good at writing as you or Otoha.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。听起来大概有点肉麻，对吧？我知道我写东西不如你和 Otoha。

lines.en: : No, it...it was nice. And it made sense. I think. I don’t know. I could probably make some sort of sense out of pretty much anything right now but that’s just how desperate I am, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不，那……那很好。而且说得通。我想。我也不知道。现在我大概能从任何话里解读出点意义来，但我想那只是因为我太绝望了吧。

lines.en: : Worried of what will happen if someone else gets to hold her instead of you?
lines.zh: : 担心的是，如果换成别人来拥有她，会怎么样？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Do you think she’s worried of the same thing?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她也在担心同样的事吗？

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许……

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed12
: I mean...I think so? Why else would she get so jealous any time literally anyone else comes up?
lines.zh: : 我是说……我想是吧？不然为什么不管是谁一靠近，她都会吃那么大的醋？

lines.en: : Maybe cause she’s...possessive? Or jealous? Or trying to overcompensate for something?
lines.zh: : 也许因为她……占有欲强？还是爱吃醋？还是在为某件事过度补偿？

lines.en: : You really don’t like her, do you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很讨厌她，对吧？

lines.en: : I have this thing where I get kinda pissed off at people who make my loved ones sad. So yeah, Otoha’s on my shit list until she starts getting her act together.
lines.zh: : 我有这么个毛病——谁让我在乎的人难过，我就会有点火大。所以没错，在 Otoha 收拾好自己的所作所为之前，她都在我的黑名单上。

lines.en: : To be honest, I don’t really know much about the girl. So the majority of my opinion on her comes from the fact that I know you have good taste in women.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我对那个女孩了解不多。所以我对她的大部分看法，都来自一个事实——我知道你挑女人的眼光很好。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed13
: Do I?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely. But ignoring that blatant pat on the back I just gave myself...I want you to know that I’ll always be here for you...and that anyone who would ever hurt you is fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 绝对是。不过先不提我刚才那记明目张胆的自我表扬……我想让你知道，我永远都会在你身边……而任何会伤害你的人，都他妈是疯子。

lines.en: : Mhm. And are you counting yourself as one of those people? Or do you want to pat yourself on the back a little bit more?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那你把自己也算在那些人里吗？还是你想再多自我表扬一会儿？

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed14
: Of course I count myself as one of those people.
lines.zh: : 我当然把自己算在那些人里。

lines.en: : All “logic” pointed toward you in my relationship with love. Same class. Close to the same age. Close to the same {i}size.{/i} You even live right across the hall from me.
lines.zh: : 在我的恋爱关系里，所有"逻辑"都指向你。同一个班。年纪相仿。{i}身材{/i}也差不多。你甚至就住在我走廊对面。

lines.en: : But the heart doesn’t care about logic. Which is probably why you’re still so down over a girl you’ve been fighting with for two months now.
lines.zh: : 可心不在乎逻辑。这大概就是为什么你还在为一个吵了两个月架的女孩这么消沉。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……

lines.en: : It really doesn’t feel like it’s been that long to me.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，真的不觉得已经过去那么久了。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed15
: It’s like I just woke up this morning and all of that time passed by without me even realizing it.
lines.zh: : 就好像我今天早上才刚醒来，而那么多时间就这么不知不觉地溜走了。

lines.en: : Maybe if...maybe if it really felt like two months...maybe then I’d be able to wrap my head around this and think more rationally, but-
lines.zh: : 也许如果……如果它真的感觉像两个月……也许那样我就能理清头绪、更理性地思考了，可是——

lines.en: : But the heart doesn’t care about logic.
lines.zh: : 可心不在乎逻辑。

lines.en: : It wants what it wants and throws a temper tantrum if it can’t have it.
lines.zh: : 它想要什么就想要什么，得不到就大发脾气。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed16
: Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Do you remember {i}why{/i} I turned you down, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我当初{i}为什么{/i}拒绝你吗，Rin？

lines.en: : It wasn’t because I didn’t like you. It was because-
lines.zh: : 不是因为我不喜欢你。而是因为——

lines.en: : Because you already had someone. I know.
lines.zh: : 因为你已经有别人了。我知道。

lines.en: : But did I ever tell you {i}who{/i} that person was? Or anything about them? Because if you knew, you’d be calling it the least logical decision of all time. And you’d see firsthand just how right I am.
lines.zh: : 可我有没有告诉过你那个人是{i}谁{/i}？或者关于他的任何事？因为如果你知道，你就会说那是有史以来最不合逻辑的决定。你也会亲眼看到我说得有多对。

lines.en: : You’re not the only one around here who’s impulsive and lovestruck and powered by desire...I’m all of those things too. Which is why I can lie here next to you right now and see where you’re coming from.
lines.zh: : 你不是这儿唯一一个冲动、被爱情冲昏头、被欲望驱动的人……我也是那样的人。所以我才能现在躺在你身边，明白你的感受。

lines.en: : The guy I’m with-
lines.zh: : 我交往的那个人——

lines.en: : I know it’s Sensei, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我知道是老师，Chika。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed17
: You-
: I’ve known the whole time.
lines.zh: : 我从头到尾都知道。

lines.en: : I mean...who else would it be?
lines.zh: : 我是说……还能有谁呢？

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : I might have lost the stupid bullshit knowledge contest to Yasu fucking Yasui, but I still know Sensei better than almost anybody.
lines.zh: : 我也许在那场该死的知识竞赛里输给了 Yasu Yasui 那个混蛋，但我对老师的了解还是比几乎任何人都深。

lines.en: : And I’ll admit that I wasn’t even {i}close{/i} to cheering you guys on in the beginning.
lines.zh: : 而且我承认，一开始我{i}根本{/i}就不支持你们。

lines.en: : I was jealous and bitter and mad and every other shitty thing a person can feel.
lines.zh: : 我嫉妒、怨毒、气愤，还有一个人能感受到的所有糟糕情绪。

lines.en: : But you guys managed to make it work, didn’t you? You’re still together all this time later while Otoha and I can’t even celebrate a single holiday together without exploding into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 可你们还是把它经营下来了，不是吗？这么久过去了你们还在一起，而我和 Otoha 连安安稳稳过一个节都做不到，每次都炸成碎片。

lines.en: : But...why didn’t you ever-
lines.zh: : 可……你为什么从来没——

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed18
: What was I going to say?
lines.zh: : 我又能说什么呢？

lines.en: : “Hey, Chika. Having a good time dating the teacher?” or “Hey, think I could borrow Sensei later if you guys aren’t busy boning? I need help with math.”
lines.zh: : "嘿，Chika。跟老师谈恋爱开心吗？"还是"嘿，要是你们不忙着做爱，之后能把老师借我一下吗？我数学需要辅导。"

lines.en: : Rin...nobody else can know about this. It’s serious. He could go to jail.
lines.zh: : Rin……这事不能让其他人知道。很严重。他可能会坐牢的。

lines.en: : Th...That’s obvious, yeah. But...uhh...the...the point is that you don’t need to go to all these lengths to explain heart logic and stuff like that to me because I already know.
lines.zh: : 那……那是当然，嗯。可是……呃……重……重点是，你不用费这么大劲跟我解释什么心的逻辑之类的，因为我已经懂了。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed19
: I know pain...and longing...and grief...because I’ve been feeling and experiencing those things in tandem with everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我懂痛苦……懂渴望……懂悲伤……因为我一直和其他人一起感受、经历着这些东西。

lines.en: : But none of that changes the position I’m in now or where I’m meant to go from here. The only one who can change any of that is me.
lines.zh: : 可这一切都改变不了我现在的处境，也改变不了我接下来该往哪儿走。唯一能改变这一切的人只有我自己。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed20
: I just wish it was a little fucking easier, you know?
lines.zh: : 我只是希望这一切能他妈稍微简单一点，你知道吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to be stuck in here. I want...I want to have fun! And make memories with all of my friends {i}and{/i} Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我不想被困在这儿。我想……我想开心一点！想和我所有的朋友、{i}还有{/i} Otoha 一起留下回忆。

lines.en: : I know...I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道……我知道。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed21
: Why doesn’t she want that too?!
lines.zh: : 为什么她就不想要呢？！

lines.en: : Why does it always have to be about someone else when it can just be about us?!
lines.zh: : 明明可以只是我们两个人的事，为什么总要扯上别人？！

lines.en: : I’m not the one making things that way! I gave up all she wanted me to give up but I can’t just rip you and Sensei out of my life like it’s nothing! I love you guys!
lines.zh: : 又不是我把事情弄成这样的！她要我放弃的我都放弃了，但我没办法就这么把你和老师从我的生活里硬生生撕掉！我爱你们啊！

lines.en: : Why can’t she just let me love you?!
lines.zh: : 她为什么就不能让我爱你们？！

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed22
: It’s not up to her or {i}anyone{/i} else to ever tell you what you should and shouldn’t feel.
lines.zh: : 该有什么感受、不该有什么感受，从来轮不到她或{i}任何人{/i}来告诉你。

lines.en: : That’s what I’ve been saying the whole time! But nope! Fuck Rin! She liked Chika {i}once{/i} so she obviously still likes her now! People never move on! That’s impossible!
lines.zh: : 我从头到尾都在说这个！可是不行！去他的 Rin！她{i}以前{/i}喜欢过 Chika，所以现在显然还喜欢她！人是永远不会放下的！那是不可能的！

lines.en: : You can’t help what you feel and she can’t help what she feels either. The only options are learning to deal with it or moving on.
lines.zh: : 你控制不了自己的感受，她也控制不了她的感受。唯一的选择就是学会接受，或者放下。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to move on and she doesn’t want to learn! So what are we supposed to do now?!
lines.zh: : 可我不想放下，而她又不肯学着接受！那我们现在该怎么办？！

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed23
: Just cry and hold my hand. The pain will hurt a little less if you have someone to share it with. And I can take it.
lines.zh: : 就哭出来，握着我的手。有人分担，痛就会轻一点。而我承受得住。

lines.en: : I know you can...you’re amazing...you’ve always been amazing...and that’s why you can be happy and mature and know how to function as one half of a couple and all I can do is complain and cry.
lines.zh: : 我知道你承受得住……你太棒了……你一直都很棒……所以你才能那么快乐、那么成熟，懂得怎么当好情侣中的一半，而我只会抱怨和哭。

lines.en: : I’m not always happy and I’m not always mature. I’m just lucky enough to have someone who’s able to put up with that.
lines.zh: : 我不是一直都快乐，也不是一直都成熟。我只是够幸运，遇到了一个能忍受这些的人。

lines.en: : And if Otoha can’t be that person for you, {i}I{/i} will.
lines.zh: : 如果 Otoha 没法成为你那个人，{i}我{/i}来当。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed24
: But we’re not {i}together.{/i} It’s not {i}you{/i} I think of the second I wake up anymore. It’s {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可我们没{i}在一起{/i}。我醒来的那一瞬间想到的不再是{i}你{/i}了。是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s not you who comes to mind when I see an old couple happily eating together through the window of a family restaurant, it’s {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当我透过家庭餐厅的窗户，看到一对老夫妻开心地一起吃饭时，我想到的不是你，是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : When {i}she{/i} sees things like that...does she think of me at all?...
lines.zh: : 当{i}她{/i}看到那样的画面时……她会不会想到我？……

lines.en: : Or does she just keep walking?
lines.zh: : 还是说她就径直走过去了？

lines.en: : How can she ignore me so easily, Chika? How doesn’t it eat away at her?
lines.zh: : 她怎么能这么轻易地无视我，Chika？这怎么就不让她心如刀绞呢？

lines.en: : What do you do when Sensei won’t look at you? How do you catch his eye?
lines.zh: : 老师不肯看你的时候，你会怎么办？你怎么把他的目光拉回来？

lines.en: : Apart from being really hot, I mean. But there’s gotta be more to it than that.
lines.zh: : 我是指，除了长得特别辣之外。总该还有别的吧。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed25
: Pfft...thank you, Rin.
lines.zh: : 噗……谢谢你，Rin。

lines.en: : I wish I had better advice to give you, but...getting someone to look my way isn’t really a strong suit of mine.
lines.zh: : 我真希望能给你更好的建议，可是……让别人把目光投向我，实在不是我的强项。

lines.en: : Sensei was looking at me before I even knew he was. And without even realizing what was happening, I just started looking at him as well.
lines.zh: : 在我意识到之前，老师就已经在看我了。然后不知不觉间，我也开始看着他了。

lines.en: : And yeah...there are times when his eyes wander somewhere else...but all I can do is sit there on the couch and have faith that he’ll come back home. And you know what?...He always {i}does.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊……有时候他的目光也会飘到别处……可我能做的，就是坐在沙发上，相信他会回家。你知道吗？……他每次{i}都会{/i}回来。

lines.en: : But that’s not because of anything {i}I’m{/i} doing. It’s because he loves me. And because I love him enough to wait.
lines.zh: : 可那不是因为{i}我{/i}做了什么。而是因为他爱我。也因为我爱他爱到愿意等。

lines.en: : So if you love Otoha...and you’re okay with waiting, do it.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你爱 Otoha……而你也愿意等，那就等吧。

lines.en: : But Rin?...I have to say this...and if you want to hate me for it, that’s fine...
lines.zh: : 可是 Rin？……有些话我必须说……如果你要因此恨我，那也没关系……

lines.en: : But you can do better.
lines.zh: : 你值得更好的。

lines.en: : You can do {i}so much{/i} better. You {i}deserve{/i} so much better.
lines.zh: : 你值得{i}好得多{/i}的人。你{i}配得上{/i}好得多的对待。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t spend every night on the couch...waiting for someone to come home just to have them leave again a week later.
lines.zh: : 你不该每晚都窝在沙发上……等着某个人回家，然后一周后他又离开。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t have to explain yourself every time you have feelings...and you shouldn’t be turned into a villain just because you have so much love to give.
lines.zh: : 你不该每次有了感情都要解释自己……也不该只是因为有太多爱可以给予，就被塑造成反派。

lines.en: : You should be treasured. The way {i}I{/i} am treasured.
lines.zh: : 你应该被珍视。就像{i}我{/i}被珍视那样。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed26
: Chika...are you...{i}really{/i} sure you’re being treasured? Because-
lines.zh: : Chika……你……{i}真的{/i}确定自己被珍视着吗？因为——

lines.en: : Yes...I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 是的……我确定。

lines.en: : I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我确定。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed27
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Yeah...
: As long as you’re sure...
lines.zh: : 只要你确定就好……

lines.en: : Rin, I’m...I’m not sure what your...pre-established limits for touching are...but you can come a little closer if my hand isn’t enough.
lines.zh: : Rin，我……我不知道你对身体接触的……既定界限是什么……但如果光是握手不够，你可以再靠近一点。

lines.en: : I’d be happy to hold you tighter until you manage to calm down.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意把你抱得更紧一点，直到你平静下来。

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i} You’re crying too, you know...
lines.zh: : {i}*抽鼻子*{/i} 你也在哭啊，你知道吗……

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i} Mhm. Which is why I made the suggestion...
lines.zh: : {i}*抽鼻子*{/i} 嗯哼。所以我才那么提议……

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’m allowed to have a platonic cuddle buddy...especially one that I masturbated to for years.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我能不能有一个纯洁的抱抱伙伴……尤其是一个我拿来打了这么多年飞机的对象。

lines.en: : You can masturbate to me whenever you want. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 你想对我打飞机随时都可以。我不介意。

lines.en: scene twogirlsonabed28
: On second thought, it’s probably better if we just lie like this instead.
lines.zh: : 再想想，我们大概还是就这么躺着比较好。

lines.en: : Yeah...I probably shouldn’t have said that. My bad.
lines.zh: : 是啊……那句话我大概不该说。我的错。

lines.en: : Thanks. Yeah. Just...gonna forget that happened.
lines.zh: : 谢了。嗯。就……当那事没发生过吧。

lines.en: : You, uhh...want a glass of water or something? I think I need some...fresh air...
lines.zh: : 你，呃……想喝杯水什么的吗？我觉得我需要点……新鲜空气……

lines.en: : One gallon of ice water, please. And if you could maybe slap me in the face a couple times too, that would be cool.
lines.zh: : 请给我一加仑冰水。另外你要是能再扇我几巴掌，那就更好了。

lines.en: : Didn’t realize you liked it rough.
lines.zh: : 没想到你喜欢这么重口的。

lines.en: : Make that two gallons of ice water, please.
lines.zh: : 那就改成两加仑冰水吧，谢谢。

lines.en: : Coming right up.
lines.zh: : 马上来。

lines.en: scene black
We have come to associate places like this with tragedy based on prior experience.
lines.zh: 基于过往的经验，我们已经把这样的地方与悲剧联系在了一起。

lines.en: Patterns, if you will.
lines.zh: 模式，如果你愿意这么叫的话。

lines.en: Remember when we heard about those just a short while ago?
lines.zh: 还记得我们不久前才听说过它们吗？

lines.en: About how hard it is to judge when a pattern is going to break...and precisely what will happen once it {i}does?{/i}
lines.zh: 说到要判断一个模式何时会被打破有多难……以及一旦{i}打破{/i}，究竟会发生什么？

lines.en: How many other dark places do you link to tragedy?
lines.zh: 还有多少黑暗的地方，被你与悲剧相连？

lines.en: How long does it take your eyes to adjust when nearly every trace of light has been killed off...like the limbs of animals in objects far too small or tight to support them?
lines.zh: 当几乎所有光的痕迹都被抹杀……就像动物的肢体被塞进太小太紧、根本容不下它们的物体里……你的眼睛要多久才能适应？

lines.en: To die in fragments is a beautiful way to go.
lines.zh: 碎裂着死去，是一种美丽的死法。

lines.en: But do you know what’s even more beautiful?
lines.zh: 但你知道什么更美吗？
